exceptions.reason: Path traversal in source-map auto-loading is a build-time devDependency risk (Tailwind's toolchain); postcss never runs against untrusted input in production and no .map files are served from user-controlled paths.

Transitive devDependency of @lhci/cli (Lighthouse CI), only invoked in local/CI performance-audit tooling against fixed, developer-controlled glob patterns — never against user input. Only available fix is a semver-major downgrade of @lhci/cli to 0.3.3.
